glosses: Wide, broad, affecting or touching upon many things.

examples.text: The government will bring in sweeping changes to the income tax system.

glosses: Moving in a continuous motion, rather than by intermittent jumps. (For example, the second hand on a clock face may move either in the sweeping manner or in the ticking manner.)
